parameters.code:
import re
headers = $action_1.headers
sender = headers.get('From', '')
reply_to = headers.get('Reply-To', '')
return_path = headers.get('Return-Path', '')
received = headers.get('Received', [])

# Extract domains
sender_domain = re.search(r'@([\w.-]+)', sender)
reply_domain = re.search(r'@([\w.-]+)', reply_to) if reply_to else None

result = {
    'sender_email': sender,
    'sender_domain': sender_domain.group(1) if sender_domain else None,
    'reply_to': reply_to,
    'reply_domain': reply_domain.group(1) if reply_domain else None,
    'return_path': return_path,
    'received_chain': received,
    'suspicious_indicators': []
}

# Check for suspicious indicators
if sender_domain and reply_domain and sender_domain.group(1) != reply_domain.group(1):
    result['suspicious_indicators'].append('Reply-To domain mismatch')

print(json.dumps(result))
